mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing reduces cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, persistent inflation triggers central bank rate hikes that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, economic slowdown reduces corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate is below 1.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by at least 0.2 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100), manufacturing contraction reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) signals policy uncertainty that increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), central bank rate hikes increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0%.
